turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale, you asked for this meeting. Why did my son get a zero?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for agreeing to meet in person.
Agreeing? I'd have been here regardless. Who decided on the zero?
I'll admit I looked you up. Your firm's appellate record is remarkable.
I didn't come here to be admired. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
Someone with your training will appreciate that I'm simply following the evidence. I expect you'd do the same in my position.
Evidence. Then show me some, Hale. And answer my question: was Owen heard before the zero went in?
